scripts.source:
valid_source() {
    local destination="$1"
    if [ "$destination" = "$2" ]; then return 1; fi
    if [ -f "$destination" ]; then return 0; fi
    return 1
}
if [ "$#" -lt 3 ] || [ -z "$2" ]; then
    printf 'Cannot build review\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
destination=$1
needle=$2
shift 2
for path in "$@"; do
    if valid_source "$path" "$destination"; then
        :
    else
        printf 'Cannot build review\n' >&2
        exit 2
    fi
done
printf 'Review: %s\n' "$needle" > "$destination"
for path in "$@"; do
    printf 'File: %s\n' "$path" >> "$destination"
    grep -F "$needle" "$path" >> "$destination"
done
printf 'Saved: %s\n' "$destination"

mode=$1
destination=$2
shift 2
sources=("$@")
if [ "$mode" = preview ] || [ "$mode" = save ]; then :; else
    printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2
fi
if [ -z "$destination" ]; then printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
for file in "${sources[@]}"; do
    if [ -z "$file" ] || [ "$file" = "$destination" ]; then
        printf 'Cannot publish handover\n' >&2; exit 2

done
report() {
    printf 'Handover\nFiles: %s\n' "${#sources[@]}"
    for file in "${sources[@]}"; do
        printf 'Source: %s\n' "$file"
        cat "$file"

        printf 'Unsafe destination\n' >&2

        printf 'Unsafe source\n' >&2
        exit 2

    if [ -f "$source" ]; then

fi
exit "$result"

scripts.source:
count=$#
if test "$count" -eq 0 || test "$((count % 2))" -ne 0; then
 printf 'Usage: transform OP SOURCE ...\n' >&2; exit 2
fi
LC_ALL=C
number=0
failed=0
while test "$#" -gt 0; do
 number=$((number + 1))
 action=$1
 file=$2
 shift 2
 ready=yes
 command=()
 case "$action" in
  ordered) command=(sort) ;;
  neighbors) command=(uniq) ;;
  owners) command=(cut -s -d ':' -f 3) ;;
  *) printf 'Rejected job %s: unknown operation\n' "$number" >&2; ready=no; failed=1 ;;
 esac
 if test "$ready" = yes; then
  case "$file" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) printf 'Rejected job %s: invalid source\n' "$number" >&2; ready=no; failed=1 ;; esac
 fi
 if test "$ready" = yes; then
  if test -f "$file"; then :; else
   printf 'Missing source for job %s: %s\n' "$number" "$file" >&2; ready=no; failed=1
  fi
 fi
 if test "$ready" = yes; then
  command=("${command[@]}" -- "$file")
  printf 'Job %s: %s\n' "$number" "$action"
  "${command[@]}"
 fi
done
exit "$failed"

scripts.source:
invalid() { printf 'Invalid transformation plan\n' >&2; }
if test "$#" -lt 4; then invalid; exit 2; fi
mode=$1
destination=$2
shift 2
count=$#
if test "$((count % 2))" -ne 0; then invalid; exit 2; fi
case "$mode" in preview|apply) : ;; *) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$destination" in ''|-|.|..|*/*|keep.txt) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
LC_ALL=C
prepare() {
 local number=0
 local action
 local file
 local command
 local result
 while test "$#" -gt 0; do
  number=$((number + 1))
  action=$1
  file=$2
  shift 2
  case "$file" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) return 2 ;; esac
  if test "$file" = "$destination"; then return 2; fi
  if test -f "$file"; then :; else return 2; fi
  command=()
  case "$action" in
   ordered) command=(sort) ;;
   neighbors) command=(uniq) ;;
   owners) command=(cut -s -d ':' -f 3) ;;
   *) return 2 ;;
  esac
  command=("${command[@]}" -- "$file")
  if result=$("${command[@]}"); then :; else return 2; fi
  printf 'Job %s: %s\nResult: <%s>\n' "$number" "$action" "$result"
 done
}
if plan=$(prepare "$@"); then :; else invalid; exit 2; fi
if test "$mode" = preview; then
 printf 'Preview\n%s\n' "$plan"
else
 printf '%s\n' "$plan" > "$destination"
 printf 'Published %s jobs to %s\n' "$((count / 2))" "$destination"
fi

scripts.source:
fail() { printf 'Cannot hand over: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 2; }
if test "$#" -gt 1; then fail 'too many arguments'; fi
mode=${1-preview}
case "$mode" in preview|publish) : ;; *) fail 'choose preview or publish' ;; esac
base_team=${BASE_TEAM:-Operations}
base_note=${BASE_NOTE-Ready}
team_one=$base_team
team_two=$base_team
note_one=$base_note
note_two=$base_note
if test -n "${TEAM1+set}"; then team_one=$TEAM1; fi
if test -n "${TEAM2+set}"; then team_two=$TEAM2; fi
if test -n "${NOTE1+set}"; then note_one=$NOTE1; fi
if test -n "${NOTE2+set}"; then note_two=$NOTE2; fi
if test -z "$NAME1"; then fail 'first job name is empty'; fi
if test -z "$NAME2"; then fail 'second job name is empty'; fi
if test -z "$team_one"; then fail 'first job team is empty'; fi
if test -z "$team_two"; then fail 'second job team is empty'; fi
report=$(printf 'Job: %s\nTeam: %s\nNote: %s\n\nJob: %s\nTeam: %s\nNote: %s\nCommon input team: <%s>\nCommon input note: <%s>\n' "$NAME1" "$team_one" "$note_one" "$NAME2" "$team_two" "$note_two" "${BASE_TEAM-not supplied}" "${BASE_NOTE-not supplied}")
case "$mode" in
 preview) printf 'Preview\n%s\n' "$report" ;;
 publish) printf '%s\n' "$report" > handover.txt; printf 'Published: handover.txt\n' ;;
esac
